body:
**QA run 2026-11-20 - CamCraft v0.24.0 + SolidCraft v0.45.0** (Linux x86_64 tarballs; SolidCraft checked against its SHA256SUMS.txt, CamCraft against the GitHub asset sha256 digest because the release has no SHA256SUMS file)

Agents: 3 headless Codex jobs (`codex exec`, default model, nice 10), with `solidcraft-cli mcp --headless` and `camcraft-cli mcp` as their only app interface. Two ran on skull and one on len. Each job designed the part in SolidCraft, saved .sc + STEP, then did machine/stock/tools/ops -> generate -> simulate/verify -> post in CamCraft. Each wrote a STEPS.log and a REPORT.md.

| Brief | Machine | Time | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| q01 2D plate (face, pocket + island, contour + tabs, spot/drill/peck/tap M6, chamfer) | Tormach 770MX | 12 min | **posted** after workarounds; 7 findings |
| q02 3D mould core (adaptive rough, rest, waterline, scallop, pencil) | Tormach 770MX | 57 min | **not posted**: STEP will not slice, .sc import refused (`blend`), waterline >900 s on the STL; 5 findings |
| q03 turned pin (face, OD rough/finish, O-ring groove + relief, M16x1.5 thread, part-off) | Tormach 15L Slant-PRO | 16 min | **not posted** (thread); a 6-op program without the thread posted; 6 findings |

Filed (all `source:agent`):
- #3019 P3: contour + tabs with the default lead is held for XY crossings
- #3020 P3: shallow Ø6 spot into a Ø5 pilot is falsely refused as a gouge
- #3021 P3: auto pocket with an island leaves 6 mm wall scallops and verify passes it
- #3022 P3: `set_operation_setup` re-sorts operations alphabetically
- #3023 P3: a modelled SolidCraft thread cannot be threaded (STEP open mesh / .sc "every axis fits")
- #3034 P3: SolidCraft STEP with an ellipsoid boss imports as an open mesh, so every 3D op refuses
- #3035 P3: 3D ops take 5-13 min, adaptive falls back silently, and a long generate blocks all MCP calls
- #3036 P7: catalog gaps (Ø3 ball, Ø6 bull nose, metric drills)

Already known (not re-filed): #2578 (.sc `blend` still refused on 0.24.0), #2579 (tab height = one stepdown; fixed on main after the tag), #2443 (no G83 choice), #893 (no thread insert fits M16x1.5), #897 (no spot-drill kind).

SolidCraft: nothing filed. Its modelled M16x1.5 thread has 0.812 mm depth. That is the ISO basic profile (5H/8), not a defect.

The runs are on the hosts, not in a repo (there is no `qa-artifacts` branch yet): `~/qa/runs/20261120-q0{1,3}-*` on skull and `~/qa/runs/20261120-q02-3d-mold` on len. The briefs are in `~/qa/briefs/q0*.md` and the job script is `~/qa/bin/qa-job.sh`. Each issue names its repro project file.
